projects.title: Decentralized Exchange
projects.alt: Illustrated exchange beside a river, used as the mark for the DEX
projects.summary: A Radix exchange with three recorded flows: connect an account, add liquidity, and swap. Components are Scrypto, the interface is React, and the front end acknowledges the Moralis DEX reference.

videos.title: Part 1 — Connecting the site to a Radix account

projects.title: Loyalty
projects.alt: Illustrated gathering, used as the mark for the loyalty project
projects.summary: Membership cards live on Radix, and points come from finished tasks and challenges rather than a private spreadsheet. The program can show its own history, and the interface acknowledges RDX Works’ Gumball Club.

projects.title: More Experience
projects.alt: Illustrated scene used as the mark for the payments work
projects.summary: At Northern Labs I took a payment service through its full lifecycle for both crypto and card payments. It spoke to Coinbase Commerce and Checkout.com, and the same stretch included onboarding and mentoring.
